name: Nourished by Time
label: XL Recordings
lede: Marcus Brown stocked shelves at a Koreatown Whole Foods, recorded Erotic Probiotic 2 in his parents' Baltimore basement for zero dollars, and landed on Pitchfork's year-end top ten twice, at No. 5 in 2023 and No. 9 in 2025.

eras.title: Two aliases, one mantra
eras.text: Brown went by two other names before settling on the one he says reminds him to keep going. Los Angeles ate the money, so he came home to Baltimore, to a basement and a pandemic.

years.src: Wikipedia: Nourished by Time · Tone Glow 133 · The Face
years.h: Brown drops two aliases and becomes Nourished by Time
years.p: After Riley With Fire and Mother Marcus, he lands on a name he calls "a mantra about staying consistent". Wikipedia notes it also nods to Guided by Voices.
years.xp:
Brown enrolled at Berklee College of Music in Boston at 17, where he credits the songwriting teacher Pat Pattison as "the only professor who let me be weird". Riley With Fire was the first project he ever wrote songs for, a college-sophomore thing steered by Foxygen, Mac DeMarco and Youth Lagoon, per Tone Glow.

He told The Face the name works as a reminder, and that he never wanted to release music under his own. Wikipedia notes the wording also echoes Guided by Voices.

years.src: Tone Glow 133 · The Line of Best Fit
years.h: Los Angeles runs out of money, so Brown goes home to Baltimore
years.p: He'd moved west after college, inspired by David Lynch films, and lasted two years before heading back just ahead of COVID.
years.xp:
The Los Angeles years included night shifts stocking shelves at Whole Foods in Koreatown, then a hunt for parking afterward, with little time for sleep or dating before the music got its turn. Per Tone Glow he came back to Baltimore because of money.

Back in his parents' house, he had a basement, a guitar and a lot of lockdown.

eras.title: A zero-dollar album in the basement
eras.text: Scenic Route Records released Erotic Probiotic 2. Pitchfork gave it Best New Music, Gorilla vs. Bear named it album of the year, and Brown had already opened US dates for Dry Cleaning that January.

years.h: Brown opens US dates for Dry Cleaning before his album exists
years.p: In January 2023 he supported the London post-punk band [[Dry Cleaning|8a74e5ea-6f68-49e1-951c-80d2291f7c3f]] in the US, and later remixed their single "Gary Ashby".

years.src: Wikipedia: Erotic Probiotic 2 · Wikipedia: Nourished by Time
years.h: Brown mixes Erotic Probiotic 2 himself, with COVID, on no budget
years.p: Brown recorded and mixed it himself in his parents' Baltimore house, on a Roland Juno-106 he bought after a Dogecoin bet paid off.
years.xp:
Wikipedia reports the album was made with a zero-dollar budget while Brown had COVID-19, which he says hurt the mixing and vocals. He calls it "just a ball of emotion", written around a breakup while he was working at Whole Foods. The sound stacks R&B, freestyle, shoegaze, post-punk and Baltimore club.

Asked about class and pop stardom, he said: "Name one socialist pop star, it doesn't exist."

years.h: Pitchfork gives Erotic Probiotic 2 an 8.2 and Best New Music
years.p: The site later put it at No. 5 on its 2023 year-end list. Gorilla vs. Bear went further and named it album of the year.

years.h: Brown turns up on Yaeji's debut and remixes Water from Your Eyes
years.p: He appears on "Happy" from [[Yaeji|2d781050-032a-4a4f-b0a9-7b4bc99449e1]]'s With a Hammer, and reworks [[Water from Your Eyes|09f91305-e193-48af-92e3-252b3dd5e718]]' "True Life".

eras.title: XL comes calling
eras.text: XL Recordings signed him in February and put out the Catching Chickens EP in March. Paste ranked "Hell of a Ride" No. 6 among the best songs of 2024.

yt: Live at The state51 Factory, London
years.h: XL Recordings signs Nourished by Time
years.p: Wikipedia dates the deal to February 2024, a year after Scenic Route put out the debut.

years.src: Wikipedia: Nourished by Time · Paste: Nourished By Time Is Possessed
yt: Hell of a Ride on Colbert
years.h: Catching Chickens gives XL its first Nourished by Time record
years.p: The EP arrived digitally on March 22 and on vinyl in May, led by "Hand on Me" and "Hell of a Ride".
years.xp: Paste ranked "Hell of a Ride" No. 6 on its list of the best songs of 2024. Pitchfork reviewed the EP the week it came out.

eras.title: Second album, second top ten
eras.text: Two singles, then The Passionate Ones in August: Pitchfork gave it 8.4 and ranked it No. 9 for the year. Brown moved to New York and toured it on 25 dates.

years.h: XL puts Erotic Probiotic 2 on vinyl, two years on
years.p: The January 24 reissue took the basement album to a wider release than Scenic Route's first run.

years.src: Wikipedia: The Passionate Ones · Wikipedia: Nourished by Time
years.h: "Max Potential" sets up the album, with Brown directing the video
years.p: The lead single, out May 7, samples Labi Siffre's "Saved".

years.src: Wikipedia: The Passionate Ones · Wikipedia: Nourished by Time
years.h: "9 2 5" turns the workweek into the second single
years.p: The video was directed by Cody Marian.

years.src: Wikipedia: The Passionate Ones · Pitchfork: The 50 Best Albums of 2025 · The Line of Best Fit
years.h: The Passionate Ones lands at 8.4, Best New Music, No. 9 of 2025
years.p: Twelve songs in 44:58, recorded across Baltimore, London and New York; Brown wrote, played, produced, mixed and engineered it himself.
years.xp:
Pitchfork gave it 8.4 and Best New Music, then ranked it No. 9 on its list of the 50 best albums of 2025, between Joanne Robertson's Blurrr and Amaarae's Black Star. Metacritic lists 89 out of 100 from 15 reviews; The Line of Best Fit gave it 9/10 and Paste named it album of the year.

Tony Bontana guests on "Jojo". "Crazy People" uses a sample from a Library of Congress collection of letters to a president, per Wikipedia.

years.h: Brown tells The Line of Best Fit where he stands
years.p: He says he'd rather challenge listeners than make them happy, and that nostalgia isn't his thing.
years.xp: In the same interview he says: "Everyone is inspired by nostalgia, but I'm not reliving anything." On what success has changed: "Money hasn't changed anything. I'm just more confused about how to help."

years.cap: Nourished by Time at Irving Plaza, New York, September 13, 2025

years.h: Brown moves to New York and plays 25 dates across North America and Europe
years.p: The run began in September and, per Bandcamp Daily, lasted three months.
